WAV demuxer (WavReader) and muxer (encodeWav).

Demuxer ports symphonia-format-riff (wave/*, common.rs): RIFF/WAVE probe, fmt ` parsing (PCM, ADPCM-MS/IMA, IEEE float, A-law, mu-law, WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE with GUID + channel-mask fixup), `fact, LIST/INFO metadata, data packetization, and timestamp seek. ADPCM params parse so the Phase-3 decoder drops in; only PCM/float/law decode today.

The muxer (encodeWav) is new work: Symphonia has no encoders. Plain fmt ` (16) for <= 2 channels, EXTENSIBLE (40) above, `fact for float/law/extensible, sizes patched on finish.

    uint8] {....raises: [AudioError], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Muxes planar samples into a complete RIFF/WAVE stream (new work). ADPCM input is sfS16, or sfS32 holding MSB-aligned S16 (the decoder's output format). The tail block is padded by repeating the final sample; fact carries the real frame count.
